projects.name: Himalayan Java
projects.lede: Redefining Nepal's pioneer coffee culture for a contemporary global audience.
projects.workDescription: Himalayan Java pioneered specialty coffee culture in Nepal. We crafted an elevated identity system that honors artisanal roots while expanding seamlessly across retail packaging, interior touchpoints, and digital ordering.

workDetails.label: Deliverables
workDetails.value: Brand Architecture, Custom Typography, Retail Packaging

projects.challenge: As competition grew, Himalayan Java needed a cohesive brand architecture that unified franchised locations while preserving local warmth and craftsmanship.
projects.approach: We developed an ecosystem centered around warmth, ritual, and origin story — pairing bespoke serif typography with organic earth tones.
projects.quote: Jungle gave our heritage brand a renewed purpose and visual language that speaks to both long-time regulars and new international guests.

results.label: Outlets unified under new brand guidelines

projects.name: Khalti Digital Wallet
projects.lede: Empowering millions with modern digital financial services.
projects.workDescription: A complete visual and experience refresh for one of Nepal's largest digital wallets. The new system simplifies complex financial transactions into friendly, approachable micro-interactions.

workDetails.label: Deliverables
workDetails.value: Brand refresh, Mobile Design System, Marketing Collateral

projects.challenge: Financial technology can feel intimidating. Khalti needed to bridge the gap between technical reliability and effortless everyday consumer habits.
projects.approach: We designed a vibrant palette, fluid micro-animations, and clean typographic hierarchy that make payments feel rewarding and intuitive.
projects.quote: The team at Jungle made our product accessible to everyone — from tech-savvy youth to first-time digital wallet users.

projects.name: Sherpa Brewery
projects.lede: Himalayan craft brewing rooted in mountain spirit and brewing mastery.
projects.workDescription: Sherpa Brewery produces authentic craft beers in the Himalayan foothills. We created a bold packaging series featuring custom woodcut illustrations and tactile finishes.

workDetails.label: Deliverables
workDetails.value: Can & Bottle Packaging, Tap Handles, POS Displays

projects.challenge: Standing out on crowded craft beer shelves while conveying the authentic story of high-altitude brewing.
projects.approach: Rich metallic accents, mountain silhouettes, and bold typography that reflect rugged elegance.
projects.quote: Our cans tell a story before the first sip. Jungle captured the soul of our brewery perfectly.

projects.name: Everest Trails
projects.lede: Sustainable trekking and cultural journeys in the high Himalayas.
projects.workDescription: Everest Trails offers responsible trekking experiences. We created an eco-focused identity along with weather-resistant physical wayfinding markers and an interactive trail guide.

workDetails.label: Deliverables
workDetails.value: Brand Guide, Physical Wayfinding, Web Experience

projects.challenge: Creating trail signage and brand materials that withstand extreme weather while respecting fragile mountain ecosystems.
projects.approach: Minimalist laser-etched slate signage combined with a lightweight offline digital guide for trekkers.
projects.quote: Jungle respected the mountains as much as we do. Their design solution is sustainable, functional, and striking.

projects.name: Basanta Textiles
projects.lede: Handwoven Himalayan woolens reimagined for modern luxury.
projects.workDescription: Basanta Textiles works with master weavers across Nepal. We elevated their brand identity to position handwoven Cashmere and Dhaka textiles in luxury international boutiques.
projects.challenge: Elevating traditional weaving from local souvenir status to high-end global luxury.
projects.approach: Tactile unbleached paper boxes, blind debossed logos, and weaver signature cards attached to every garment.
projects.quote: Our artisans take immense pride seeing their work presented with such elegance and respect.

projects.name: Post Cast
projects.scope: Audio Identity, Web Platform, Podcast Cover Art
projects.lede: Nepal's premier investigative journalism podcast network.
projects.workDescription: Post Cast brings in-depth reporting into the audio space. We crafted a distinctive audio sonic mark, podcast cover art templates, and a streamlined audio web player.

workDetails.label: Deliverables
workDetails.value: Sonic Signature, Cover Art System, Web Audio Player

projects.challenge: Building a unified media identity for diverse shows ranging from daily news summaries to long-form investigative audio.
projects.approach: A modular typographic frame system with high-contrast editorial photography and a signature sound logo.
projects.quote: Jungle gave our audio journalism a distinct identity that listeners instantly recognize across podcast platforms.

projects.name: Goldstar Footwear
projects.lede: An iconic everyday sneaker transformed into a streetwear staple.
projects.workDescription: Goldstar is a household footwear brand. We led the creative campaign repositioning Goldstar sneakers among urban youth and street style subcultures.

workDetails.label: Deliverables
workDetails.value: Campaign Photography, Video Spots, Streetwear Lookbook

projects.challenge: Transitioning a utilitarian mass-market shoe into an aspirational lifestyle brand without alienating loyal buyers.
projects.approach: Gritty urban photography, neon typography, and collaborations with local musicians and skateboarders.
projects.quote: Jungle tapped into youth culture in a way that felt authentic, energetic, and undeniably fresh.

projects.name: Marks & Spaces
projects.lede: Spatial design studio crafting minimal urban interventions.
projects.workDescription: Marks & Spaces designs minimal architectural interiors. We designed an identity based on architectural grids, blind embossing, and a high-performance portfolio website.

workDetails.label: Deliverables
workDetails.value: Brand System, Monograph Print Book, Portfolio Website

projects.challenge: Reflecting architectural precision and spatial elegance through print and digital collateral.
projects.approach: Monochrome palette, strict grid alignment, oversized photography, and refined architectural typography.
projects.quote: The identity Jungle created feels like an extension of our architectural philosophy — clean, structured, and timeless.
